description: Prescriptive D3FEND-mapped mitigation guidance for OT/ICS threats. Pass one of actor, cve_id, or technique_id, optionally with vendor_stack. Returns matched ATT&CK ICS techniques mapped to D3FEND defensive countermeasures with priority and rationale, plus prescriptive architecture recommendations. DeepSeek-synthesised, ICD-203 estimative language. Price: $0.20 USDC per call via x402 on Base mainnet. An unpaid call returns an x402 PaymentRequired challenge; retry the identical call with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"].

actor.description: Threat actor name e.g. SANDWORM. At least one of actor, cve_id, or technique_id is required.

cve_id.description: CVE identifier. At least one of actor, cve_id, or technique_id is required.

technique_id.description: MITRE ATT&CK ICS technique ID e.g. T0836. At least one of actor, cve_id, or technique_id is required.

vendor_stack.description: Optional vendor/product context e.g. Schneider Modicon

name: getMitigationMap
title: D3FEND-Mapped Mitigation Guidance
